summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper and enumeration. Changes: botocore/regions.py adds `import enum` and EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, enum.Enum) with the eleven members and comments. botocore/args.py imports the enum as EPRBuiltins, adds ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults after _ensure_boolean, and makes _should_set_global_sts_endpoint accept a None endpoint config (treated as no variant tags). tests/unit/test_args.py adds TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with 24 tests covering each behavioral criterion, including one test each for custom-data and bundled-data SDK endpoint. Results: test_args.py 59 passed; test_regions, test_client, test_args, test_utils together 694 passed. No added line exceeds 79 columns. Nothing committed. Choices: the bridge's existing private lookups (_resolve_endpoint_variant_config_var, _resolve_use_dualstack_endpoint) are used for FIPS and DualStack; a None S3 config is normalized to {}; the test class sits at the end of test_args.py without importing the enum.
